dataBiosphere

Auditable cinematic metaphors for high-risk research findings.

dataBiosphere converts high-risk findings (health, finance, regulation) into auditable cinematic video and interactive simulation. It enforces three non-negotiable rules:

  • Literal core + metaphorical shell — metaphor encodes the qualities of a number (large/small, certain/uncertain), never replaces it.
  • Freeze-frame test — if a finding (effect size / CI / n) is not recoverable from any single frame, that scene is manipulation and forbidden.
  • Faithfulness constraint — metaphor may not imply what the data does not support.

Installation 

devtools::install_github("ahmetkutuk1/dataBiosphere")

Usage 

library(dataBiosphere)

m <- metaphorMatrix("S7", "survival")
m$family       # "fluvial"

overlay <- truthOverlay(
  effect_type = "HR", effect_value = 0.72, ci_lower = 0.61, ci_upper = 0.85,
  n = 1200, finding_label = "Treatment X vs placebo", risk_tier = 1, contains_mortality = TRUE
)
overlay$badge
# "HR = 0.72 (95% CI 0.61-0.85; n = 1,200)"

Severity threshold

Findings involving death, illness, or trauma (contains_mortality = TRUE) cannot be delivered as Tier 3 (game). truthOverlay() errors out if you try.

Tier Format When
T1 Cinematic video High risk
T2 Interactive exploration Medium risk
T3 Serious game Low risk only
